roadmap.title: Syria and the Siberian Wilderness
roadmap.description: Play the opening chapters. Enter the Syrian tomb, survive the first night and the avalanche, and learn crafting, translating and the first tools.

roadmap.title: Soviet Installation
roadmap.description: Rescue Jacob from the gulag, open the Soviet Installation side missions and collect the first weapons, tombs and challenges.

roadmap.title: Geothermal Valley
roadmap.description: Light the signal fire, defend the Remnant village, finish the valley missions and hunt valley animals.

roadmap.title: Mid-game chapters
roadmap.description: Play the Flooded Archives, Research Base and Orrery chapters to recover the Atlas and rescue Jonah.

roadmap.title: Path of the Deathless and the Lost City
roadmap.description: Open the path to Kitezh, finish the story and clear the endgame on the chosen difficulty.

roadmap.title: Free roam and 100% completion
roadmap.description: After the story, revisit every region for collectibles, challenges, missions, tombs and crypts, then farm the leftover combat and exploration goals.

roadmap.title: Expeditions: Score Attack and cards
roadmap.description: Replay levels in Score Attack, buy and collect cards, and finish the no-damage and gold-score goals.

roadmap.title: Baba Yaga: Temple of the Witch
roadmap.description: Play the Wicked Vale story, its lift, outfits, Dreamstinger, collectibles and Score Attack levels.

roadmap.title: Blood Ties and Lara's Nightmare
roadmap.description: Explore Croft Manor, solve the safe and finish both the Blood Ties story and the Lara's Nightmare survival mode.

roadmap.title: Endurance expeditions
roadmap.description: Survive and escape the Endurance forest with the matching challenges equipped before each run.

roadmap.title: Cold Darkness Awakened
roadmap.description: Run Cold Darkness with the matching challenges equipped, collecting documents and rescuing prisoners.

roadmap.title: Endurance Co-op
roadmap.description: Play Endurance with a second player and equip the matching challenges before each run.

achievements.description: Melee kill an enemy using a bottle
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a melee stealth takedown while holding a bottle.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Deadly Force} in the brawler skills.
Pick up a bottle, sneak up behind an unaware enemy, and use the melee stealth kill.

achievements.description: Perform 25 special stealth kills with the knife
achievements.summary: Make 25 special knife stealth kills.

guide.context: Get the combat knife first. Buying @mechanic{Deadly Force} gives stealth kills the special animation. Do this in the story or free roam, not through chapter replay or a checkpoint restart.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Deadly Force} in the brawler skills.
Sneak up behind unaware enemies and stealth kill them. It still counts if another enemy spots you once the takedown has started.
After the story, fast travel to the @loc{Siberian Wilderness} for a group of enemies. They return after you fast travel away and back.

achievements.description: Stealth kill an enemy while he is having a conversation
achievements.summary: Stealth kill an enemy while that enemy is talking with another enemy.

steps.text: Find two enemies talking to each other, such as in the first enemy area of the @loc{Acropolis} chapter.
Sneak up and stealth kill one of them while they are talking.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies with one Poison Arrow
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemies with a single poison arrow.

guide.context: The poison arrow range upgrade helps. Lure the enemies into a tight group before you shoot.

steps.text: Craft a poison arrow from a normal arrow, cloth and mushrooms.
Alert a group of enemies and fall back to a narrow spot so they bunch up. A good spot is the red vehicle near the exit at the @loc{Research Base}.
Shoot one poison arrow into the middle of the group.

achievements.description: Craft 5 pieces of Equipment
achievements.summary: Craft 5 pieces of equipment.

steps.text: At a campfire, open Inventory, then Equipment.
Craft any 5 pieces, such as quivers or ammo pouches.

achievements.description: Headshot an enemy with an arrow from a distance beyond 25m
achievements.summary: Land an arrow headshot on an enemy standing more than 25 meters away.

steps.text: Find a group of unaware enemies, such as the first group in the @loc{Acropolis} chapter.
Back away as far as you can, aim the bow, and shoot one in the head.

achievements.description: Craft 25 of each special arrow type (Fire, Grenade, Poison)
achievements.summary: Craft 25 fire arrows, 25 grenade arrows, and 25 poison arrows.

guide.context: Each craft makes 3 arrows, so make each type 9 times. You can craft arrows anywhere, not only at campfires.

steps.text: Gather cloth, oil, magnesite, and mushrooms.
Shoot off 3 arrows, then pick an arrow type and hold the craft button. Fire needs oil, grenade needs magnesite, and poison needs mushrooms, each with cloth and a normal arrow.
Repeat until you have crafted 25 of each type.

achievements.description: Reach max proficiency in one language
achievements.summary: Raise one language (Greek, Russian, or Mongolian) to its maximum level.

guide.context: Reading murals, documents and other finds raises your level. Maximum levels are Greek 7, Russian 3, and Mongolian 2, and you need only one language.

steps.text: Read every mural and document you find.
Check the language screen and stop when one language is at its top level.

achievements.description: Drown 3 enemies using a water finisher
achievements.summary: Drown 3 enemies with the underwater finisher.

guide.context: You must be swimming and grab an enemy who stands near the edge of the water.

steps.text: Swim up to an enemy standing at a ledge by the water.
Use the melee button to pull him under. Reload the checkpoint and repeat until you have drowned 3.
A good spot is the start of the @loc{Approaching Storm} chapter.

achievements.description: Unearth 40 Survival Caches
achievements.summary: Dig up 40 Survival Caches.

guide.context: Survival Caches show on the map once you find the Explorer Satchel for that area. Survival instinct also highlights them.

steps.text: In each area, find the @item{Explorer Satchel} to mark its Survival Caches on the map.
Dig up caches until the count reaches 40. If you need locations, look up an interactive map of the area.

achievements.description: Kill 6 enemies with the Revolver without reloading
achievements.summary: Take down 6 enemies using only the Revolver, with no reload in between.

guide.context: The Revolver holds 7 rounds, so you can miss once. Headshots on unarmored enemies kill fastest.

steps.text: Get the @item{Revolver} in the @loc{Soviet Installation} chapter.
Find a group of 6 unarmored enemies, such as the start of the @loc{Acropolis} chapter.
Headshot them one by one without reloading.

achievements.description: Translate one Monolith
achievements.summary: Translate one Monolith.

guide.context: You need the right language level first. The first Monolith in Syria needs Greek level 1.

steps.text: In the Syria area, look at the wall paintings around the room until you reach Greek level 1.
Go back to the @item{Monolith} and translate it.

achievements.description: Melee 5 enemies off a ledge
achievements.summary: Melee 5 enemies off a ledge.

guide.context: The enemies do not have to die from the fall. Make sure they have noticed you first, or you will do a stealth takedown instead.

steps.text: Find enemies standing near a ledge, such as the first group in the @loc{Copper Mill} chapter.
Strike them with melee until they fall. After a fall, reload the checkpoint and try again until you have 5. Do not kill all 4 or the checkpoint changes.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies within 10 seconds using any rifle
achievements.summary: Use a rifle to kill 5 enemies in a 10-second window.

guide.context: A louder weapon draws enemies together, which helps. Play on the lowest difficulty.

steps.text: Start the @loc{Acropolis} chapter's first fight, where more enemies arrive after the first 4.
Shoot quickly and accurately with a rifle. The AK-47 works well. Replay the chapter and try again if you fall short.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies by shooting them in the leg
achievements.summary: Get 10 kills where the final shot hits the enemy's leg.

steps.text: Aim at an enemy's leg with a gun and make that shot the killing one.
A good place is the @loc{Acropolis} chapter. Use a checkpoint restart to repeat fights.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies with 1 Shotgun blast
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies with a single shotgun blast.

guide.context: If the kill does not register, limit the game's frame rate to 60 and try again. For the easy setup, finish Soviet Installation first, then use Chapter Replay Elite so you keep your shotgun and skills. Choose Adventurer difficulty.

steps.text: Replay the Soviet Installation chapter with Chapter Replay Elite on Adventurer difficulty.
Equip your highest damage shotgun.
Wait behind cover until two enemies by the fuel leak call a third over.
Get as close as you can behind all 3 and fire once.

achievements.description: Defeat two enemies or more using a single Molotov Cocktail
achievements.summary: Defeat 2 or more enemies with a single Molotov cocktail.

guide.context: You can do this as soon as you learn to craft Molotovs.

steps.text: In the @loc{Copper Mill} chapter, pick up the bottle and cloth and craft a @item{Molotov cocktail}.
Wait until 3 enemies stand close together, then throw it at them.

achievements.description: Kill any animal with an explosive
achievements.summary: Kill an animal with an explosive.

guide.context: Explosive arrows unlock near the end of the story.

steps.text: After you get explosive arrows, go to an area with animals, such as the @loc{Geothermal Valley}.
Shoot an animal with an explosive arrow.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade one weapon
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade one weapon.

guide.context: The climbing axe is the easiest to finish. It has only 4 upgrades.

steps.text: Gather the materials for the climbing axe upgrades.
Upgrade it at a campfire until it is complete.

achievements.description: Shoot a bottle out of the air
achievements.summary: Shoot a bottle while it is in the air.

guide.context: A shotgun is the easiest weapon for this.

steps.text: Fast travel to the @loc{Ruins Encampment} campfire in the @loc{Geothermal Valley}. A basket there holds endless bottles.
Throw a bottle, switch to a shotgun, and shoot the bottle in the air.

achievements.description: Shoot a chicken out of the air with a fire arrow
achievements.summary: Shoot a chicken in mid-air with a fire arrow.

guide.context: Fire arrows are available once you reach the Geothermal Valley.

steps.text: Pick up a chicken near the @loc{Ruins Encampment} or @loc{Valley Farmstead} campfire in the @loc{Geothermal Valley}.
Throw it above you and hit it with a fire arrow. If it lands head down in the ground, a fire arrow also counts.

achievements.description: Complete a level in Score Attack with a card bonus of 200% or more
achievements.summary: Clear a Score Attack level while your card bonus is at least 200%.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Score Attack} and pick a short Challenge Tomb.
Equip cards with drawbacks, such as no health regeneration or no starting ammo, until the bonus shows 200% or more, then finish the level.

achievements.description: Complete a level in Score Attack using 5 cards
achievements.summary: Finish a Score Attack level with 5 cards equipped.

guide.context: Any five cards count. A short Challenge Tomb is the fastest level.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Score Attack} and pick a Challenge Tomb you have already finished in the main game.
Equip five cards and finish the level.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Replay Challenges in one Score Attack level
achievements.summary: Clear 3 Replay Challenges within a single Score Attack level.

steps.text: Before you start a short level in @mechanic{Score Attack}, pick up to 5 Replay Challenges.
Finish the level and complete at least 3 of the challenges you picked.

achievements.description: Uncover the remains of all of Jacob's disciples.
achievements.summary: Open the sarcophagus in all 5 crypts to uncover the remains of Jacob's disciples.

guide.context: There are 5 crypts: two in the Soviet Installation, two in the Geothermal Valley, and one in the Lost City. The Intuitive skill shows their locations on the map.

steps.text: Buy the @mechanic{Intuitive} skill so crypts show on the map.
Visit the crypts: two in the @loc{Soviet Installation}, two in the @loc{Geothermal Valley}, and one in the @loc{Lost City}.
Open the sarcophagus in every crypt.

achievements.description: Purchase all items from the Supply Shack
achievements.summary: Buy every item in the Supply Shack.

guide.context: Items cost ancient coins. Coins come from Coin caches, which appear after you translate nearby Monoliths, and from crypts and challenge tombs. Coins in underground places may not show on the map.

steps.text: Unlock the @loc{Supply Shack} in the @loc{Soviet Installation} by playing the story.
Collect coins from Coin caches, crypts, and challenge tombs.
Buy every item in the shop.

achievements.description: Enter the Lost Prophet's tomb in Syria.
achievements.summary: Enter the Lost Prophet's tomb in Syria during the story.

steps.text: Play the opening Syria chapter until Lara walks into the @loc{Syrian tomb}.

achievements.description: Survive a night in the Siberian wilderness.
achievements.summary: Survive the first night in the Siberian wilderness during the story.

steps.text: Keep playing the story through the Siberian wilderness until the night ends.

achievements.description: Rescue Jacob from the gulag.
achievements.summary: Rescue Jacob from the gulag during the story.

steps.text: Play the story through the Soviet Installation until you free Jacob from the @loc{gulag}.

achievements.description: Light the signal fire in the Remnant Valley.
achievements.summary: Light the Remnant Valley's signal fire as part of the story.

steps.text: Play the story in the @loc{Geothermal Valley} until Lara lights the signal fire.

achievements.description: Defend the Remnants from the Trinity invasion.
achievements.summary: Protect the Remnants during the Trinity attack in the story.

steps.text: Play the story until the Trinity attack on the Remnant village and fight it off.

achievements.description: Recover the Atlas.
achievements.summary: Recover the Atlas during the story.

steps.text: Play the mid-game chapters until Lara gets the @item{Atlas}.

achievements.description: Rescue Jonah from Konstantin.
achievements.summary: Rescue Jonah from Konstantin during the story.

steps.text: Play the story until Lara reaches Jonah and rescues him from @npc{Konstantin}.

achievements.description: Unlock the path to Kitezh.
achievements.summary: Unlock the path to Kitezh during the story.

steps.text: Play the Path of the Deathless chapter until the way to Kitezh opens.

achievements.description: Finish the game on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the story on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish the story. Any difficulty works.

achievements.description: Finish the game on Survivor difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the story on Survivor difficulty.

guide.context: Finishing on Extreme Survivor also unlocks this achievement. Survivor turns off health regeneration, so craft med kits to heal.

steps.text: Start the story on Survivor, or on Extreme Survivor if you are going for that achievement too.
Carry cloth and herbs so you can craft med kits at any time.
Finish the story.

achievements.description: Attend a funeral
achievements.summary: Attend the funeral in the Geothermal Valley after the Flooded Archives chapter.

guide.context: Do not walk to the story objective next to the Ridgeline camp. That ends the chapter, and you would have to replay it.

steps.text: Finish the Flooded Archives chapter and head up toward the observatory.
From the @loc{Ridgeline} campfire, walk a short way downhill to the grassy ledge where a crowd stands.
Stand near them until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Dive into a well
achievements.summary: Dive into a well.

steps.text: Go to the village in the @loc{Geothermal Valley}.
Get on the roof by the well and jump off the ramp.
Jump while holding aim to dive into the well.

achievements.description: Find the best seat in the house
achievements.summary: Sit in the wooden chair on top of the old tower near the Ruins Encampment.

guide.context: This is not the signal tower from the story. The right tower is near a Monolith, and you swing over to it from another tower on a tree branch.

steps.text: Fast travel to the @loc{Ruins Encampment} campfire in the @loc{Geothermal Valley}.
Climb the old tower near the camp.
Use the interact button on the chair at the top.

achievements.description: Replay 5 different levels without taking any damage
achievements.summary: Replay 5 separate levels and take no damage in any of them.

guide.context: Fall damage counts as damage. If the unlock does not appear, cap your frame rate at 60.

steps.text: Finish five Challenge Tombs in the main game so they can be replayed.
Open Expeditions and replay each tomb without taking any damage.

achievements.description: Kill a razorback boar using a Molotov cocktail
achievements.summary: Kill a razorback boar with a Molotov cocktail.

guide.context: Boars live in the Geothermal Valley and do not always appear. Fast travel away and back to refresh them.

steps.text: Pick up a bottle, such as from the crate at the @loc{Ruins Encampment} campfire, and craft a @item{Molotov cocktail}.
Find a razorback boar on the map and throw the Molotov at it.

achievements.description: Kill 50 animals while wearing the Huntress outfit
achievements.summary: Wearing the Huntress outfit, kill 50 animals.

guide.context: You get the outfit by finishing the A Hearty Meal mission in the Geothermal Valley.

steps.text: Finish the two valley hunter missions: Surveillance Disruption, then A Hearty Meal.
Equip the @item{Huntress outfit} at a campfire.
Kill 50 animals. Chickens at the @loc{Ruins Encampment} and @loc{Valley Farmstead} campfires respawn when you fast travel between them.

achievements.description: Beat 15 combat encounters after completing the game
achievements.summary: Win 15 combat encounters after finishing the story.

guide.context: Encounters only count after the story is complete. Enemies in cleared areas return after you fast travel away and back.

steps.text: Finish the story.
Fast travel to the @loc{Siberian Wilderness}. Lure the enemies near the campfire and kill every enemy in each group.
Fast travel away and back to respawn them. Repeat until 15 groups are cleared.

achievements.description: Complete any Challenge Tomb
achievements.summary: Complete one Challenge Tomb.

guide.context: Tombs show on the map once you are near them. The Baths of Kitezh and the Catacomb of Sacred Knowledge are in the Geothermal Valley.

steps.text: Find a Challenge Tomb marked on the map, such as in the @loc{Geothermal Valley}.
Solve it and finish the puzzle.

achievements.description: Achieve 100% game completion
achievements.summary: Reach 100% completion of the base game.

guide.context: This counts only the base game. It covers the story, side missions, challenge tombs, crypts, challenges, and collectibles of these kinds: Murals, Relics, Documents, Strongboxes, Survival Caches, and Coin caches. Expansion items are not part of it.

steps.text: Finish the story.
Check the world map for each region's missing items. Underground places such as tombs, crypts, and caves may not show on the map, so look there first for missing items.
Do the missions, challenges, tombs, crypts, and collectibles until the completion screen reads 100%.

achievements.description: Complete every level in Score Attack with a gold score
achievements.summary: Finish every Score Attack level with a gold score.

guide.context: Challenge Tombs appear once you have finished them in the main game. Play on Survivor, which triples the score.

steps.text: Earn a gold score on every level in @mechanic{Score Attack}.
Copy a top player's cards from the leaderboard for 2000 credits when a level stays out of reach.

achievements.description: Perform a manual zip line transfer
achievements.summary: Let go of a zip line yourself and drop onto another zip line.

guide.context: If you fail, reload the checkpoint.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Copper Mill Bridge} base camp, where two long zip lines connect.
Ride the first zip line and drop with the drop button a moment before Lara lets go on her own.
Land on the second zip line.

achievements.description: Perform a 2.5 second or longer swan dive
achievements.summary: Hold a swan dive for at least 2.5 seconds.

guide.context: This dive spot is not available until the way to Kitezh is open. Jumping from the board itself sometimes fails. Jumping from the cliff one step to its right works better.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Ridgeline} campfire in the @loc{Geothermal Valley} and find the diving board above the nearby waterfall.
Jump from the cliff just right of the board.
Hold the aim button right away to start the swan dive. Reload the checkpoint if it fails.

achievements.description: Heal yourself in combat 3 times
achievements.summary: Heal yourself with a med kit 3 times during combat.

steps.text: Craft med kits from 1 leaf and 1 cloth.
During a fight, hold the heal button to use one. Do it 3 times.

achievements.description: Defeat a Deathless Swordsman using only melee attacks and a finisher
achievements.summary: Beat one Deathless Swordsman with melee attacks only, ending with a finisher.

guide.context: In the brawler tree, learn Dodge Counter, then Dodge Kill, then its Mastery upgrade.

steps.text: Buy the three dodge skills in the brawler tree.
In the @loc{Path of the Deathless} chapter, face the first swordsman.
Dodge his attack, then press melee in the counter window.
Use only melee, ending with one finisher.

achievements.description: Get 25 headshots using the Bolt-Action Rifle
achievements.summary: Get 25 headshots with the base-game Bolt-Action Rifle.

guide.context: You unlock this rifle by finding 4 parts in strongboxes. The Goldenfang rifle and other add-on rifles do not count. Do this in the story or free roam, not through chapter replay or a checkpoint restart.

steps.text: Find the 4 rifle parts in strongboxes to unlock the @item{Bolt-Action Rifle}, then equip it at a campfire.
Headshot enemies until you reach 25. After the story, fast travel to the @loc{Siberian Wilderness} to farm respawning enemies.

achievements.description: Shoot 15 deer in the heart
achievements.summary: Shoot 15 deer in the heart.

guide.context: Anatomical Knowledge comes from finishing the Catacomb of Sacred Knowledge tomb in the Geothermal Valley. It makes survival instinct show each deer's heart. The True Shot skill then aims for you. Deer do not always spawn, so fast travel around to refresh them.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Catacomb of Sacred Knowledge} tomb in the @loc{Geothermal Valley} to learn Anatomical Knowledge.
Buy True Shot by owning the double shot and triple shot skills.
Find deer in the Siberian Wilderness, Soviet Installation or Geothermal Valley. Use survival instinct, aim the bow, and shoot the highlighted heart. Do it 15 times.

achievements.description: Complete all Challenge Tombs in one playthrough
achievements.summary: Complete all 9 Challenge Tombs in a single playthrough.

guide.context: Some tombs only open later in the story. Tombs also give skill bonuses.

steps.text: Check the world map for the tomb count in each region.
Solve each Challenge Tomb in turn until all 9 are done. If you need puzzle help, look up a video for the tomb.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Missions
achievements.summary: Complete 3 side missions from non-player characters.

guide.context: The first missions are in the Soviet Installation.

steps.text: Talk to the man in the @loc{Logging Camp} in the Soviet Installation.
Finish three missions, such as Communications Breakdown, Dangerous Territory, and The Unlucky Ones.

achievements.description: Complete every Mission
achievements.summary: Complete all 9 side missions.

guide.context: Ancient Secrets only opens once you have unlocked the Lost City and finished all nine challenge tombs.

collectibles.name: Communications Breakdown
collectibles.method: Destroy five communication towers.
collectibles.note: Available once you reach the Soviet Installation and speak to him.

collectibles.name: Dangerous Territory
collectibles.method: Locate the wolves' den and wipe out what is inside.
collectibles.note: Available on your return visit to the Soviet Installation.

collectibles.name: Gulag Recon
collectibles.location: @npc{Man} by the campfire in the cave north of the Hidden Refuge
collectibles.method: Go to the Gulag and find three intel items.

collectibles.name: The Unlucky Ones
collectibles.method: Go back to the Gulag and release two prisoners.

collectibles.name: Misguided Intelligence
collectibles.method: Locate the messenger bird and shoot it down.

collectibles.name: Defensive Strategy
collectibles.method: Collect four hardwood and two deer hides, then deliver the supplies to both towers.
collectibles.note: Hardwood lies in the forest. Deer live deeper in the forest.

collectibles.name: Surveillance Disruption
collectibles.location: @npc{Hunter} standing by the house close to the second tower
collectibles.method: Take down the five recon drones around the valley.

collectibles.name: A Hearty Meal
collectibles.location: @npc{Hunter} standing by the house close to the second tower
collectibles.method: Skin two wild boars and collect four mushrooms.
collectibles.note: Opens after Surveillance Disruption. Boars are east of where the mission starts.

collectibles.name: Ancient Secrets
collectibles.location: @npc{Herbalist} inside the ruins, bottom right of the map
collectibles.method: Complete all nine Challenge Tombs, then report back.
collectibles.note: Opens only after the Lost City is unlocked.

achievements.description: Complete 5 Challenges
achievements.summary: Complete 5 challenges.

guide.context: Open the world map and select the Challenges tab to see active ones.

steps.text: Do the Soviet Installation challenges first. There are 4 there, plus single challenges in Syria and the Siberian Wilderness.
Check the map's Challenges tab for progress.

achievements.description: Complete every Challenge
achievements.summary: Complete all 18 challenges.

guide.context: Some challenges need story tools, so they open later. Use the map's Challenges tab to track progress. If one does not register, return to its area later; areas can be revisited.

collectibles.name: Hang 'em High
collectibles.location: Prophet's tomb area at the end of the level
collectibles.method: Shoot 7 hanging incense burners. Two are visible before you flood the room. The other five appear after you flood it.

collectibles.name: Grab and Go
collectibles.method: Loot 3 Trinity soldier corpses.
collectibles.note: If it does not register, come back to the area later.

collectibles.name: Data Corruption
collectibles.method: Destroy 10 red laptops. Five are in the first fight after Lara splits from Jacob, one is behind the gate, and the rest are on the way to the railroad.

collectibles.name: Difference of Opinion
collectibles.method: Burn 7 Cosmonaut posters. Molotovs work for most. The last poster, in the room where the mill first catches fire, needs a fire arrow.

collectibles.name: Into Darkness
collectibles.method: Walk into 5 caves. Any of the 8 cave entrances or 2 crypt entrances counts.

collectibles.name: Capture the Flag
collectibles.method: Cut down 7 Soviet flags with the combat knife. One hangs at the Copper Mill Yard entrance.

collectibles.name: Fowl Play
collectibles.method: Pick up chickens and throw 5 of them into the wooden pen in front of the pumpkin patch.

collectibles.name: Bull's Eye
collectibles.location: Mostly the west of the valley
collectibles.method: Shoot the center of 8 bull's-eyes. The white outer ring does not count, and you can shoot as often as you like.

collectibles.name: Hung Out to Dry
collectibles.method: Cut down 6 hanging rabbits.

collectibles.name: High Diving
collectibles.method: Dive off all 4: the southern hunting tower, near the Baths of Kitezh cave entrance, the signal fire island, and above the waterfall.
collectibles.note: Finish the Defensive Strategy mission first. The waterfall platform opens after the observatory base camp.

collectibles.name: Tossing Gourds
collectibles.method: Throw pumpkins into 5 barrels. Survival instinct makes the barrels behind fences easier to hit.

collectibles.name: Cut Short
collectibles.method: Shoot down 6 walkie talkies: 1 at the valley entrance, 3 in the market, 1 past the broken bridge, and 1 in the tent by the last campfire.

collectibles.name: Scorched Earth
collectibles.method: Shoot 4 fuel tanks. The last is outside the holding cells, so reach it on foot. Fast travel skips it.

collectibles.name: Enemy of My Enemy
collectibles.method: Shoot red Greek Fire pots to light 6 braziers. Use a rope arrow on the rope-wrapped blockade and shoot the wooden beams over the last pot.

collectibles.name: Vandal
collectibles.location: Around and on top of the fortress ruins
collectibles.method: Destroy 8 headless statues.

collectibles.name: For Whom the Bell Tolls
collectibles.location: High places in the main city, often towers
collectibles.method: Cut down 5 bells.

collectibles.name: Banner Wars
collectibles.location: Walls of the main city buildings
collectibles.method: Burn 8 Deathless banners.

collectibles.name: Burn Baby Burn
collectibles.method: Use a trebuchet to light 5 signal fires. Fire arrows do not work. The far north-west tower needs the north-east trebuchet.

achievements.description: Collect 25% of all narrative assets (relics, murals, and documents)
achievements.summary: Collect 25% of all relics, murals, and documents.

guide.context: Each area's Explorer Satchel and Archivist Map, plus its translated Monoliths, put these on your map. Survival instinct highlights them.

steps.text: Pick up Relics, read Documents, and examine Murals as you play.
Check the world map for each area's collected count. If you need locations, look up an interactive map of the area.

achievements.description: Collect 75% of all narrative assets (relics, murals, and documents)
achievements.summary: Collect 75% of all relics, murals, and documents.

guide.context: Same as the 25% milestone: Explorer Satchels, Archivist Maps and translated Monoliths mark items on the map.

steps.text: Keep collecting Relics, Documents, and Murals in every area.
Check the world map for what is missing. If you need locations, look up an interactive map of the area.

achievements.description: Purchase all skills in one category
achievements.summary: Buy every skill in one skill category.

guide.context: Take the Finesse skill early. It gives extra experience for stealth kills and headshots, so you earn skill points faster.

steps.text: Pick one category, such as brawler or hunter.
Spend every skill point in that category until it is complete.

achievements.description: Survive the avalanche.
achievements.summary: Survive the avalanche during the story.

steps.text: Keep playing the story. The achievement unlocks when you come through the avalanche.

achievements.description: Collect 150 cards
achievements.summary: Collect 150 cards.

guide.context: Cards you use up still count. The card packs that come with the Season Pass in this game give about 200 cards, which is more than the 150 you need. Buying cards needs an online connection.

steps.text: Open the Season Pass card packs in the @mechanic{Expeditions} marketplace. Each pack holds 5 cards.
If you are still short of 150 cards, buy the cheapest card packs with credits.
Earn credits by replaying chapters and getting gold scores in Score Attack, and claim the free packs in the Gifts section after 100% completion.

achievements.description: Collect 300 cards
achievements.summary: Collect 300 cards.

guide.context: Buying cards needs an online connection. Cards you use up still count. The card packs that come with the Season Pass in this game already give about 200 cards, so only about 100 more need buying. The cheapest pack costs 5000 credits, so 20 packs cost 100,000.

steps.text: Open the Season Pass card packs in the @mechanic{Expeditions} marketplace first. They give about 200 cards.
Buy the cheapest card packs for the remaining 100 cards. That is 20 packs, or 100,000 credits.
Earn credits by replaying chapters and getting gold scores in Score Attack, and claim the free packs in the Gifts section after 100% completion.

achievements.description: Complete 10 different levels in Score Attack with a gold score
achievements.summary: Finish 10 different Score Attack levels with a gold score.

guide.context: Each gold also pays 10,000 credits for card packs. To use a top player's cards, open the level in the main-menu leaderboards, pick a high score, and confirm the 2000-credit prompt.

steps.text: Earn a gold score on 10 different levels in @mechanic{Score Attack}. Start with the short challenge tombs.

achievements.description: Complete a level in Score Attack with a gold score
achievements.summary: Finish any Score Attack level with a gold score.

guide.context: A short Challenge Tomb is the quickest level to try. Playing on Survivor triples the score.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Score Attack} and pick a short level.
Equip cards that raise the score, such as no starting ammo, and finish fast on Survivor.

achievements.description: Complete every level in Score Attack with a bronze score or better
achievements.summary: Finish every Score Attack level with a bronze score or better.

guide.context: Challenge tombs appear once you have finished them in the main game.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Score Attack} and finish every level with at least a bronze score.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Speak to Nadia again before leaving the Wicked Vale
achievements.summary: Talk to Nadia a second time before you leave the Wicked Vale.

guide.context: If you already left the Vale, fast travel back to Witch's Cave Base Camp and talk to her there.

steps.text: Go to @npc{Nadia} in the ruins near @loc{Witch's Cave Base Camp} and talk to her again.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Collect at least 10 Artifacts
achievements.summary: Collect 10 Artifacts in one Endurance expedition.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges.

steps.text: Equip the Master Archaeologist challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Pick up Artifacts in the wilderness and crypts until you have 10 in the same expedition.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Open 5 Codices or Sarcophagi
achievements.summary: Open 5 Codices or Sarcophagi in Endurance.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges. Each crypt holds one Codex or Sarcophagus, so you need to reach 5 crypts.

steps.text: Equip the Raider challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Enter crypts and open the Codex or Sarcophagus inside each one until you have opened 5.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Open 5 Codices or Sarcophagi without getting caught in a trap
achievements.summary: Open 5 Codices or Sarcophagi in Endurance without being caught in any trap.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges. Being caught in a trap fails the count, so check every crypt with survival instinct, including on the way out.

steps.text: Equip the Skillful Raider challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Before entering a crypt, fill your food meter. Learn the Bright Eyes skill or equip the gold Tomb Raider card, then use survival instinct to find traps.
Shoot every trap in your path instead of walking into it.
Open the Codex or Sarcophagus, then leave the same careful way. Repeat until 5 are opened.
If a trap catches you, the slow-motion moment means this attempt has failed.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Destroy 3 ceiling spike traps after being caught in them
achievements.summary: Destroy 3 ceiling spike traps after each one has caught you in an Endurance expedition.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges. Each whole trap counts once, not each separate spike.

steps.text: Equip the Fast Reflexes challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Walk into a ceiling spike trap so it catches you.
Destroy that trap completely. Do this with 3 different traps.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Eat the meat of 5 birds, squirrels, or rabbits that were killed with fire
achievements.summary: In Endurance, eat meat from 5 birds, squirrels or rabbits after killing each one with fire.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges.

steps.text: Equip the Well Done challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Shoot a bird, squirrel or rabbit with a fire arrow.
Pick up and eat the meat. Repeat until you have eaten 5.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Eat the meat of 5 wolves that were killed with poison damage
achievements.summary: In Endurance, eat meat from 5 wolves after killing each one with poison damage.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges.

steps.text: Equip the Still Tastes Good challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Kill a wolf with poison damage, then eat its meat. Repeat until you have eaten 5 poisoned wolves.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Escape the forest on day 1, without recovering any artifacts
achievements.summary: In Endurance, get out of the forest on day 1 while holding no Artifact.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges. Do not pick up any Artifact on the way.

steps.text: Equip the Nope challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Leave the forest through the escape point on day 1 without taking any Artifact.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Escape the forest after surviving for 7 days
achievements.summary: Leave the forest in Endurance once you have lasted 7 days.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges. Survive 7 full days first, then leave the forest.

steps.text: Equip the Vacation challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Stay alive for 7 days.
Leave the forest through the escape point once the 7 days are over.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Escape the forest after surviving 10 days, with at least 10 Artifacts
achievements.summary: Lasting 10 days, leave the forest in Endurance while carrying 10 or more Artifacts.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges. Both the 10 days and the 10 Artifacts must be done in the same run.

steps.text: Equip the Great Haul challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Collect at least 10 Artifacts while you survive for 10 days.
Leave the forest through the escape point after day 10 is over, still carrying the Artifacts.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Survive for 5 days
achievements.summary: Survive 5 days in Endurance.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges. You can stack this with other day-count challenges in one run.

steps.text: Equip the Happy Camper challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Keep warm, fed and healthy until day 5 is over.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Survive for 7 days
achievements.summary: Survive 7 days in Endurance.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges. You can stack this with other day-count challenges in one run.

steps.text: Equip the Nature Retreat challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Keep warm, fed and healthy until day 7 is over.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Survive for 10 days
achievements.summary: Survive 10 days in Endurance.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges. One long run can cover this together with Great Haul and the shorter day-count challenges.

steps.text: Equip the Great Outdoors challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Keep warm, fed and healthy until day 10 is over.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Warm up from freezing by standing in fire
achievements.summary: In Endurance, stand inside a harmful fire to recover from freezing.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges. A campfire does not count. The fire must be one that can hurt you.

steps.text: Equip the One Way to Do It challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Wait until your character is freezing.
Throw a lantern on the ground, then stand in the fire it makes until you warm up.
The fire damages you, so keep your health up.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Locate 5 crypts
achievements.summary: Locate 5 crypts in Endurance.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges.

steps.text: Equip the Who Needs a Map challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Search the wilderness until you have found 5 crypts.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Rescue Nadia from Trinity
achievements.summary: Rescue Nadia from Trinity in the Baba Yaga story.

guide.context: The Baba Yaga story opens once you are past the gulag in the main story.

steps.text: Play the opening of the @loc{Baba Yaga} story until you free @npc{Nadia} from the @enemy{Trinity} soldiers.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Enter the Wicked Vale
achievements.summary: Enter the Wicked Vale in the Baba Yaga story.

steps.text: Follow the story after rescuing @npc{Nadia} until you walk into the @loc{Wicked Vale}.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Face the Witch and live
achievements.summary: Face the witch in the Baba Yaga story and survive.

steps.text: Keep following the story objective until the witch confrontation ends with Lara still alive.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Craft the Antidote
achievements.summary: Craft the antidote in the Baba Yaga story.

steps.text: Follow the story objective and craft the @item{antidote} when the game asks for it.

achievements.displayName: Last Ride of the Witch House
achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Activate the Ancient Lift
achievements.summary: Activate the Ancient Lift in the Baba Yaga story.

guide.context: The Lift is the gondola that crosses the canyon between the two base camps.

steps.text: Follow the story until you start the @mechanic{Ancient Lift} and ride it.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Unmask Baba Yaga
achievements.summary: Unmask Baba Yaga to finish the Baba Yaga story.

steps.text: Finish the story fight in the arena and watch the witch be unmasked.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Complete the Challenge in the Wicked Vale
achievements.summary: Shoot all 10 hanging lanterns in the Wicked Vale.

guide.context: You can do this after you make the antidote or after you beat the witch. If you miss some, fast travel to @loc{Witch's Cave Base Camp}, board the Lift, and pull its switch with a rope arrow to ride the route again.

collectibles.name: Lantern 1
collectibles.location: Hanging over the quarry's eastern edge
collectibles.method: Shoot it with the bow or a rifle if the pistol cannot reach.

collectibles.name: Lantern 2
collectibles.location: Hanging over the quarry's eastern edge
collectibles.method: Shoot it from the quarry floor.

collectibles.name: Lantern 3
collectibles.location: Under a stone archway west of the quarry
collectibles.method: Shoot it from the quarry or from the platform with the Lift lever.

collectibles.name: Lantern 4
collectibles.location: Just above and right of lantern 3
collectibles.method: Shoot it the same way as lantern 3.

collectibles.name: Lantern 5
collectibles.location: Directly ahead under the stone arch after lantern 4
collectibles.method: Shoot it from the front of the Lift; it can only be hit from this side.

collectibles.name: Lantern 6
collectibles.location: Under a stone archway to the south
collectibles.method: Turn left and shoot it.

collectibles.name: Lantern 7
collectibles.location: In an alcove to the north
collectibles.method: Turn right and shoot it.

collectibles.name: Lantern 8
collectibles.location: Left side of the Lift, very close to its path
collectibles.method: Shoot it as the Lift passes.
collectibles.note: You can also hit it from the back of the Lift while it waits at Witch's Cave Base Camp.

collectibles.name: Lantern 9
collectibles.location: Left side, just below the water wheel
collectibles.method: Shoot it as the Lift passes.
collectibles.note: From the camp, look down over the right edge near the waterfall.

collectibles.name: Lantern 10
collectibles.location: Hanging below the platform where the Lift stops
collectibles.method: Shoot it as you approach.
collectibles.note: From the camp you can hit it through the gap in the walkway.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Unearth all Survival Caches in the Wicked Vale
achievements.summary: Dig up all 6 Survival Caches in the Wicked Vale.

guide.context: The Explorer Satchel in the arena shows where the caches are. The forest ones need the antidote first.

collectibles.name: Survival Cache 1
collectibles.location: Forest south of @loc{Wicked Vale Base Camp}
collectibles.method: Take the path right after the passage. It is buried on the southwest edge. Look for the flashing light.

collectibles.name: Survival Cache 2
collectibles.method: Pass the storage boxes, squeeze through the rock gap, turn right, and dig behind the tree at the first bend.

collectibles.name: Survival Cache 3
collectibles.location: Next to the Lift handle at @loc{Witch's Cave Base Camp}
collectibles.method: Dig beside the rope-wrapped handle that moves the Lift.

collectibles.name: Survival Cache 4
collectibles.method: It is at the left end of the passage that holds the Explorer Satchel.
collectibles.note: To reach the passage, swim across the pool, climb onto the small floating pallet, and jump to the ledge.

collectibles.name: Survival Cache 5
collectibles.method: Leave the passage, turn right, and pull the wooden barrier down with a rope arrow. Climb the ledge ahead and dig under the two dangling platforms.

collectibles.name: Survival Cache 6
collectibles.location: Top tier, northern end of the arena
collectibles.method: Dig in the raised alcove near the last vat.
collectibles.note: For a shortcut from the middle-level east ledge, climb north through the room with the Archivist Map and up two ledges.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Collect 50% of the Documents in the Wicked Vale
achievements.summary: Pick up 50% of the Wicked Vale Documents.

guide.context: The Wicked Vale has 21 Documents, so about 11 is half. The full list is in the Complete History of Witchcraft entry. The forest ones need the antidote first.

steps.text: Pick up Documents around @loc{Wicked Vale Base Camp}, the tunnel northeast of it, the forest and quarry, and the rope works until about 11 are found.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Collect all of the Documents in the Wicked Vale
achievements.summary: Collect every Document in the Wicked Vale.

guide.context: The Vale has 21 Documents. The grapple axe is needed to reach them all. The forest ones need the antidote, and numbers 16 to 21 appear only after the witch is beaten.

collectibles.name: Document 1
collectibles.method: Pick it up from the ground.

collectibles.name: Document 2
collectibles.location: Top of the stairs north of the camp
collectibles.method: Take it from the crate.

collectibles.name: Document 3
collectibles.method: Follow the tunnel past the distilling vat, jump into the pool, and swim over to the south ledge.

collectibles.name: Document 4
collectibles.location: Canyon holding the rusted tanks and pipes
collectibles.method: Jump onto the stone pillar between the waterfalls, turn around, and grapple-swing across the gap on the metal rings.

collectibles.name: Document 5
collectibles.location: Ledge by the broken distilling vat gate
collectibles.method: Drop to the ledge below and right of the vat, then pull down the barrier with a rope arrow.

collectibles.name: Document 6
collectibles.location: Dark passage northeast of the camp
collectibles.method: Take it from the worktable in the torch room.

collectibles.name: Document 7
collectibles.location: Far northeast corner of the forest
collectibles.method: Go up the stairs, through the vale, and south. This needs the antidote.

collectibles.name: Document 8
collectibles.method: Walk southeast to the storage boxes and take it from a box.

collectibles.name: Document 9
collectibles.method: Squeeze through the rock gap past the boxes, go southeast, and drop into the quarry.

collectibles.name: Document 10
collectibles.method: Take it from the crate.

collectibles.name: Document 11
collectibles.method: Swim into the crack in the wall to the end of the dead-end passage.

collectibles.name: Document 12
collectibles.method: Use the dangling wooden platforms to reach the second winch on the southwest, then hop across the broken wall.

collectibles.name: Document 13
collectibles.method: Stand in the Lift facing southwest and jump to the alcove marked by two burning torches.

collectibles.name: Document 14
collectibles.method: Take it from the crate.

collectibles.name: Document 15
collectibles.location: First round room inside the ruins
collectibles.method: Take it from the crate that @npc{Nadia} uses as a table.

collectibles.name: Document 16
collectibles.location: Flooded passage below the first round room
collectibles.method: Take the stairs by the dead soldier and swim the flooded passage. A side branch on the left, just before its end, holds the document.

collectibles.name: Document 17
collectibles.method: Climb the stairs northwest of Nadia's room. It is in the room with the ladder and rugs.

collectibles.name: Document 18
collectibles.method: Climb the walls in the north alcove, turn around, and swing over with the grapple axe.

collectibles.name: Document 19
collectibles.method: Ride a wooden platform to the north side and jump onto the ledge with the murals.

collectibles.name: Document 20
collectibles.method: Ride a platform to the northeast vat ledge, jump off, and climb into the alcove behind the vat.

collectibles.name: Document 21
collectibles.location: High alcove, southern wall of the arena
collectibles.method: Begin at the fourth vat in the southwest and complete the timed climb.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Complete a Wicked Vale Score Attack with a gold score
achievements.summary: Finish a Wicked Vale Score Attack level with a gold score.

guide.context: Speed, collected blue spheres, shot yellow lanterns, Survivor difficulty and score cards all raise the score. Cards that start you with no ammo give a large boost.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Score Attack} from Expeditions and pick a Wicked Vale level.
Equip score-boosting cards, play on Survivor, and finish quickly to reach gold.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Complete every Wicked Vale Score Attack with a gold score
achievements.summary: Finish every Wicked Vale Score Attack level with a gold score.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Score Attack} and get a gold score on each Wicked Vale level it lists.
To copy a top run's cards, open that level in the main-menu leaderboards, pick a high score, and confirm the 2000-credit prompt.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Attempt any Wicked Vale Score Attack
achievements.summary: Play any Wicked Vale Score Attack level.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Score Attack} from Expeditions and play any Wicked Vale level.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Equip the Dreamstinger and Wraithskin outfit together
achievements.summary: Equip the Dreamstinger and the Wraithskin outfit at the same time.

steps.text: Open the equipment menu and equip the @item{Dreamstinger} and the @item{Wraithskin} outfit together.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Confuse an enemy with the Dreamstinger
achievements.summary: Confuse one enemy with the Dreamstinger.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Dreamstinger} and hit an enemy with it so the enemy is confused.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Confuse 3 enemies with one shot from the Dreamstinger
achievements.summary: Confuse 3 enemies with a single Dreamstinger shot.

steps.text: Wait until three enemies stand close together.
Fire one @item{Dreamstinger} shot at them so all three are confused.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Confuse 10 enemies with the Dreamstinger
achievements.summary: Confuse 10 enemies with the Dreamstinger.

guide.context: If the count does not move, cap your frame rate at 60 and try again.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Dreamstinger} and confuse enemies with it until you have confused 10.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Kill 10 enemies while wearing the Wraithskin outfit
achievements.summary: Defeat 10 enemies with the Wraithskin outfit on.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Wraithskin} outfit and kill 10 enemies.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Kill 50 enemies while wearing the Wraithskin outfit
achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies with the Wraithskin outfit on.

guide.context: Only kills made while the outfit is on count. If the count does not move, cap your frame rate at 60 and try again.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Wraithskin} outfit and kill 50 enemies.

achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Fall to your death from the Lift
achievements.summary: Die by falling off the Lift in the Wicked Vale.

steps.text: Ride the @mechanic{Lift} and jump off so Lara falls to her death.

achievements.description: Endurance Challenge: Collect at least 5 Artifacts
achievements.summary: Collect 5 Artifacts in one Endurance expedition.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds only about 4 or 5 challenges.

steps.text: Equip the Archaeologist challenge, then start an Endurance expedition.
Pick up Artifacts in the wilderness and crypts until you have 5 in the same expedition.

achievements.displayName: Why the Chicken Crossed the Vale
achievements.description: Baba Yaga: Ride the Lift back to the other side
achievements.summary: Make the return trip on the Lift across the Wicked Vale.

steps.text: Fast travel to @loc{Witch's Cave Base Camp} and board the @mechanic{Lift}.
Pull the switch with a rope arrow to send the Lift back east, and ride it across.

achievements.description: Cold Darkness Challenge: Collect all 8 documents
achievements.summary: Collect all 8 Documents in one Cold Darkness run.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds up to 5 challenges. Finish collecting before you enter the third tower, because after that nothing can be collected.

steps.text: Equip the Uncovering the Truth challenge, then start a Cold Darkness run from Expeditions.
Pick up the Archivist Map from the ground at the top of the ladder. It marks every document.
Collect all 8 Documents. Use survival instinct to find them.
Do this before you enter the third tower.

achievements.description: Cold Darkness Challenge: Kill 20 enemies with Dragonfire Shotgun Rounds
achievements.summary: Defeat 20 enemies using Dragonfire Shotgun Rounds in Cold Darkness.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds up to 5 challenges.

steps.text: Equip the Give a Man a Fire challenge, then start a Cold Darkness run.
Pick up a shotgun and the Dragonfire rounds that enemies drop.
Kill 20 enemies with Dragonfire rounds.

achievements.description: Cold Darkness Challenge: Pick up 6 different weapons
achievements.summary: Pick up 6 different weapons in one Cold Darkness run.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds up to 5 challenges. Finish before you enter the third tower. The helicopter sometimes marks weapon locations, and the Intuitive skill helps too.

steps.text: Equip the Armed For Bear challenge, then start a Cold Darkness run.
Search the map and pick up 6 different weapons.

achievements.description: Cold Darkness Challenge: Get 5 headshots with the regular arrows in 1:00
achievements.summary: Get 5 headshots with regular arrows within 1 minute in Cold Darkness.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds up to 5 challenges. Use regular arrows only. Cards that give all skills and a fully upgraded bow help.

steps.text: Equip the Spinning Leaf challenge, then start a Cold Darkness run. Choose cards that give a fully upgraded bow.
Take a good shooting spot and aim at infected soldiers' heads.
Land 5 headshots with regular arrows inside 1 minute.

achievements.description: Cold Darkness Challenge: Open 6 upgrade pry chests
achievements.summary: Open 6 upgrade pry chests in one Cold Darkness run.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds up to 5 challenges. There is a chest on top of each tower and others around the map. The map does not show them.

steps.text: Equip the Legendary Gunsmith challenge, then start a Cold Darkness run.
Find and open pry chests on each tower top and around the three main areas until you have opened 6.
Leave the chest on top of the last tower for last.

achievements.description: Cold Darkness Challenge: Rescue 6 prisoners
achievements.summary: Rescue 6 prisoners in one Cold Darkness run.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds up to 5 challenges. Finish before you enter the third tower. The helicopter sometimes marks prisoner locations, and the Intuitive skill helps too.

steps.text: Equip the To the Rescue challenge, then start a Cold Darkness run.
Find prisoners around the map and rescue 6.

achievements.description: Cold Darkness Challenge: Shut down all the towers without any mistakes
achievements.summary: Shut down all 3 towers in Cold Darkness without making a mistake.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds up to 5 challenges. Follow the instructions you hear exactly. An alarm or mistake fails it.

steps.text: Equip the Perfectionist challenge, then start a Cold Darkness run.
Shut down each of the 3 towers, following the spoken directions carefully, with no alarms.

achievements.description: Cold Darkness Challenge: Complete Cold Darkness
achievements.summary: Complete a Cold Darkness run.

steps.text: Start a Cold Darkness run from Expeditions.
Shut down the facility and finish the run.

achievements.description: Cold Darkness Challenge: Kill 75 enemies in a single Cold Darkness run
achievements.summary: Defeat 75 enemies during one Cold Darkness run.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds up to 5 challenges.

steps.text: Equip the An Ocean in Storm challenge, then start a Cold Darkness run.
Keep killing infected soldiers until the total reaches 75.

achievements.description: Cold Darkness Challenge: Complete Cold Darkness without dying
achievements.summary: Complete Cold Darkness without dying.

guide.context: Equip the matching challenge before the run starts. A run holds up to 5 challenges. Buff cards and a lower difficulty make the run easier.

steps.text: Equip the Combat Specialist challenge, then start a Cold Darkness run.
Finish the run without dying.

achievements.description: Blood Ties: Collect all of the Documents in Croft Manor
achievements.summary: Collect every Document in Croft Manor.

guide.context: You can return to the manor after the story to pick up missed Documents.

steps.text: Search every room of @loc{Croft Manor} for Documents. Look up an interactive map of Croft Manor to see where the items are.

achievements.description: Lara's Nightmare: Destroy a Skull of Rage
achievements.summary: Break one Skull of Rage during Lara's Nightmare.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Lara's Nightmare} from Expeditions and destroy a @enemy{Skull of Rage}.

achievements.description: Lara's Nightmare: Defeat 100 enemies
achievements.summary: Defeat 100 enemies in Lara's Nightmare.

steps.text: Fight the zombies in @mechanic{Lara's Nightmare} until you have defeated 100.
steps.note: Take the shotgun from the upper floor if you want a stronger weapon.

achievements.description: Blood Ties: Collect all of the Relics in Croft Manor
achievements.summary: Collect every Relic in Croft Manor.

guide.context: You can return to the manor after the story to pick up missed Relics.

steps.text: Search every room of @loc{Croft Manor} for Relics. Look up an interactive map of Croft Manor to see where the items are.

achievements.description: Blood Ties: Acquire the Master Key
achievements.summary: Get the Master Key in Croft Manor during Blood Ties.

steps.text: Use Lara's childhood @item{Expedition Map} to locate the way into the @loc{Servants' Passage}.
Find a @item{flashlight}, then follow the passage to the @loc{Library}.
Use the @item{Secret Map} in the Library to find the @item{Master Key}.

achievements.description: Blood Ties: Find truth of Croft Manor
achievements.summary: Finish the Blood Ties story by finding the truth about Croft Manor.

steps.text: Find a way to read the @item{Blank Letter} and solve its mystery.
Look around @loc{Lord Croft's Secret Vault} for clues, then work out how to leave it.
Work out the @item{Sun Shaped Plaque} riddle.
Investigate the @loc{Croft Family Crypt} to end the story.

achievements.description: Blood Ties: Open Lord Croft's Safe
achievements.summary: Open Lord Croft's safe in the Study of Croft Manor.

guide.context: Lord Croft's safe is in the Study. Its combination comes from relics and clues found in other rooms of the manor.

steps.text: Search the @loc{Library}, @loc{Atelier} and @loc{Master Bedroom} for the combination relics.
Find the clues in the @loc{Master Bedroom} and @loc{Atelier}.
Return to the @loc{Study} and enter the combination on the safe.

achievements.description: Blood Ties: Collect 50% of the Documents in Croft Manor
achievements.summary: Collect half of the Documents in Croft Manor.

guide.context: You can return to the manor after the story to pick up missed Documents.

steps.text: Search the rooms of @loc{Croft Manor} for Documents until half are collected. Look up an interactive map of Croft Manor to see where the items are.

achievements.description: Blood Ties: Collect 50% of the Relics in Croft Manor
achievements.summary: Collect half of the Relics in Croft Manor.

guide.context: You can return to the manor after the story to pick up missed Relics.

steps.text: Search the rooms of @loc{Croft Manor} for Relics until half are collected. Look up an interactive map of Croft Manor to see where the items are.

achievements.description: Lara's Nightmare: Defeat the Nightmare
achievements.summary: Defeat the Nightmare to finish Lara's Nightmare.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Lara's Nightmare} to the end and defeat the Nightmare.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Eat the meat of 3 bears with your partner
achievements.summary: Eat the meat of 3 bears while your partner is next to you in Endurance Co-op.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. Stay close to your partner. A two-player icon on the eat prompt shows you are in range.

steps.text: Equip the A Feast for Two challenge in a co-op expedition.
Kill a bear and eat its meat while your partner is in range. Repeat until you have eaten 3.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Eat the meat of 3 wolves with your partner
achievements.summary: Eat the meat of 3 wolves while your partner is next to you in Endurance Co-op.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. Stay close to your partner. A two-player icon on the eat prompt shows you are in range.

steps.text: Equip the A Dinner for Two challenge in a co-op expedition.
Kill a wolf and eat its meat while your partner is in range. Repeat until you have eaten 3.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Eat the meat of 5 rabbits or squirrels with your partner
achievements.summary: In Endurance Co-op, eat 5 rabbits or squirrels while your partner is in range.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. Stay close to your partner. A two-player icon on the eat prompt shows you are in range.

steps.text: Equip the A Snack for Two challenge in a co-op expedition.
Kill rabbits or squirrels. Eat each one while your partner is in range and the two-player icon shows.
Repeat until you have eaten 5.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Escape the forest with 5 Artifacts
achievements.summary: Escape the forest with 5 Artifacts in Endurance Co-op.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these.

steps.text: Equip the Adventure Friends challenge in a co-op expedition.
Collect 5 Artifacts together.
Leave the forest through the escape point with them.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Escape the forest with 5 Medium and Large Artifacts
achievements.summary: In Endurance Co-op, leave the forest carrying 5 medium or large Artifacts in total.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. Medium Artifacts are Codices and large ones are Sarcophagi, one per crypt. The player who equipped the challenge should pick them up, with the partner close by.

steps.text: Equip the Adventure Besties challenge in a co-op expedition. The host should be the one who equips it.
Open crypts and take the Codex or Sarcophagus in each, until you carry 5 in total.
Leave the forest through the escape point with them.
If it does not unlock, make sure at least 2 of the 5 are Codices.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Kill a combined total of 10 dangerous animals in a single Expedition
achievements.summary: Together with your partner, kill 10 dangerous animals in one Endurance Co-op expedition.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. Dangerous animals are wolves, bears and lynxes. Both players' kills add to one total.

steps.text: Equip the Sisters of Artemis challenge in a co-op expedition.
Hunt wolves, bears and lynxes until you and your partner have killed 10 in total.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Kill a combined total of 25 enemies in a single Expedition
achievements.summary: Together with your partner, kill 25 enemies in one Endurance Co-op expedition.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. Enemies are Trinity soldiers, Deathless and Infected. Both players' kills add to one total.

steps.text: Equip the Sisters of Athena challenge in a co-op expedition.
Fight enemy soldiers until you and your partner have killed 25 in total.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Escape the forest after 7 days without using a single revive
achievements.summary: Escape the forest after 7 days in Endurance Co-op without using a revive.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. Leave on day 8, after 7 full days. Neither player may be revived during the run.

steps.text: Equip the Team Survival challenge in a co-op expedition.
Survive 7 days without either player going down and being revived.
Leave the forest through the escape point on day 8.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Revive a player
achievements.summary: Revive your partner in Endurance Co-op.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. If the session will not connect or lags, both players can switch to game build 811.3, cap the frame rate at 60 and use DirectX 11.

steps.text: Equip the Pick-Me-Up challenge in a co-op expedition.
Let your partner go down, then revive them.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Revive a player 3 times in a single expedition
achievements.summary: Revive a player 3 times in one Endurance Co-op expedition.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. The run starts with only 2 revives. Opening a crypt and taking its Codex or Sarcophagus gives another.

steps.text: Equip the No One Left Behind challenge in a co-op expedition.
Open a crypt and take its Codex or Sarcophagus to gain an extra revive.
Revive a player 3 times in the same expedition.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Kill an enemy melee attacking your partner
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy that is attacking your partner in melee in Endurance Co-op.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these.

steps.text: Equip the Get Away from Her! challenge in a co-op expedition.
When an enemy attacks your partner up close, kill that enemy.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Escape the forest after surviving for 7 days with at least 10 Artifacts
achievements.summary: Escape the forest after 7 days in Endurance Co-op with at least 10 Artifacts.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. Leave on day 8, after 7 full days, carrying at least 10 Artifacts.

steps.text: Equip the Bonding Time challenge in a co-op expedition.
Collect at least 10 Artifacts while you survive 7 days.
Leave the forest through the escape point on day 8.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Spend at least one day more than 60 meters apart
achievements.summary: Spend one full in-game day more than 60 meters from your partner in Endurance Co-op.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. A full day means one day and one night. Distance makes the player who joined lag more, so do this with a stable connection.

steps.text: Equip the Alone Time challenge in a co-op expedition.
Split from your partner and stay more than 60 meters apart for one full day and night.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Kill 5 enemies that have been marked by your partner
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemies that your partner has marked in Endurance Co-op.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these.

steps.text: Equip the Communication Skills challenge in a co-op expedition.
Have your partner aim at an enemy with the right mouse button and press space to mark it. A skull icon appears.
Kill the marked enemy. Repeat until you have killed 5.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Escape the forest after surviving 10 days with at least 20 Artifacts
achievements.summary: Escape the forest after 10 days in Endurance Co-op with at least 20 Artifacts.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. Leave on day 11, after 10 full days. About 4 days of searching is enough to find 20 Artifacts.

steps.text: Equip the Master and Apprentice challenge in a co-op expedition.
Collect at least 20 Artifacts while you survive 10 days.
Leave the forest through the escape point on day 11.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Clear 3 Enemy Camps at night in a single expedition
achievements.summary: In one Endurance Co-op expedition, wipe out 3 Enemy Camps after dark.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. An Enemy Camp has a burning barrel, armed soldiers and a weapons crate or orange tent nearby.

steps.text: Equip the For the Night is Dark challenge in a co-op expedition.
At night, find an Enemy Camp and kill every soldier in it. Do this for 3 camps in the same expedition.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Warm up from freezing by standing next to a campfire lit by your partner
achievements.summary: Warm up from freezing at a campfire that your partner lit in Endurance Co-op.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. Freezing means the heat meter flashes red. Being in the red is not enough.

steps.text: Equip the Teamwork challenge in a co-op expedition.
Wait until your heat meter flashes red.
Have your partner light a campfire, then stand next to it until you warm up.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Collect an Artifact while your partner is down
achievements.summary: In Endurance Co-op, pick up an Artifact while your partner is knocked down.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. This is a different challenge from the plain Teamwork one.

steps.text: Equip the "Teamwork" challenge, the one about Artifacts, in a co-op expedition.
Find an Artifact and get your partner into the down state, for example with a poison arrow.
Pick up the Artifact while your partner is down, then revive them.

achievements.description: Endurance Co-op Challenge: Eat with your partner while at least one of you is starving
achievements.summary: In Endurance Co-op, share a meal with your partner while one or both of you is starving.

guide.context: Both players share the equipped challenges. Each player can equip 2, so a run can earn up to 4 of these. Starving means the food meter flashes red. Being in the red is not enough.

steps.text: Equip the Say "Aaah" challenge in a co-op expedition.
Wait until one player's food meter flashes red.
Eat any food, such as a food bag from a camp, while the co-op symbol shows your partner is in range.

achievements.description: Finish the game on Extreme Survivor difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the story on Extreme Survivor difficulty.

guide.context: Finishing on Extreme Survivor also unlocks the Survivor and any-difficulty achievements. This mode saves only at campfires, so a death costs everything since the last one. You take more damage, headshots are harder, and resources are scarcer.

steps.text: Play the story on Extreme Survivor difficulty.
Finish the story.
